title: Waterfall close
prompt_en: 16:9. Close view of a jungle waterfall, water cascading over mossy rocks, mist rising, ferns trembling in the spray. Slight slow motion, lush green, bright diffused light.
prompt_zh: 16:9。丛林瀑布近景，水流从长满苔藓的岩石上倾泻，雾气升腾，蕨类在水雾中颤动。轻微慢动作，郁郁葱葱的绿色，明亮漫射光。
why_it_works: Secondary motion (ferns trembling, mist) adds realism around the main water motion.
